title: land_review_not_ready hold names a release that does not clear it
description:
The final-review hold fires after the review attempt was dispatched, so it carries an attempt and the per-kind decision names the settle release for it — but releasing the review attempt clears nothing: the next resume re-reads the NOT READY verdict from the PR and holds again. The refusal's own message names the real moves (fix and run again, merge the PR by hand, or close it), so the hold's clearing command is arguably the resume, the same shape the world holds got here.
evidence: internal/reconcile/land.go:501 (the refusal prose) — the command named is the settle for the review attempt, which no run_held line's release disposes
